elements.label: EXAMPLE 8.1
elements.title: Problem and Solution for Regulatory Compliance in Data Collection

nodes: Problem: Gadget Galaxy's data collection violates regulatory compliance
Option a: Outsource data collection to third-party specializing in compliance
Option b: Continue project without policies due to small business status
Option c: Conduct simple training and create own policies
Option d: Halt project and seek expert guidance
Solution: Correct choice is d, halt project and seek expert guidance, conduct training, and perform external review
connections: Problem leads to options a, b, c, d
Solution selects option d as correct
Solution includes training and external review after halting project

elements.summary: This example presents a problem scenario where a company violates data collection compliance and lists four possible action plans. The solution identifies the correct action as halting the project and seeking expert guidance to develop proper policies.
